bayts.text: and by the sanctity of (his) sons and (his) daughters, and by the sanctity of the Family together with the wives,
and by the sanctity of the Messengers and the Prophets, of the learned together with the saints,
and by the sanctity of the radiant, noble angels, and by the sanctity of the Kaʿba, Your sacred House,
and by the sanctity of the mighty Holy House (Jerusalem), and by the city of Your noble Messenger (Medina),
and by Your Frequented House (Qurʾān 52:4), O Lord, and the angels who visit it above the sky,
and by the standing of everyone possessed of guidance, whether righteous, or spiritual guide, or worshipper, or sincere counsellor,
and by the standing of everyone who is attributed to You: grant me all that I ask of You.
And swiftly spare me all that I seek refuge from in You, O Giver of refuge.
And join, here, me and what drives me toward You, wherever it is known;
and all that hinders from You, O Originator (Al-Badīʿ), separate it swiftly from me.
I am the one who has submitted his face here to You, resolved to do good;
I am the one who never inclines toward any other than You, here and then tomorrow.
And why not, when You are my Lord, the Trustee, and You suffice me, so I do not incline (elsewhere)?
O Kind, You are my Lord, the Bestower, and of Your (spiritual) openings I have no doubt.
O Kind, You are my Lord, the Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), and You suffice me, so I am not disappointed.
O Just, You are my Lord, the Defender, and You suffice me, so I do not defend (myself).
O Living, You are the Possessor of Majesty, the All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), and You suffice me, so I do not contend.
O Lord, You are the Possessor of might (Qurʾān 13:13), the One, and You suffice me, so I do not suffer.
O Singular, You are the Possessor of gifts, O Glorious (Al-Mājid), and You suffice me, so I do not envy.
My Master, You are the Possessor of guidance, O Benefiter (An-Nāfiʿ), and You suffice me, so I do not sever (ties).
You are the One Who grants Your guidance to those who love You, and You suffice me, so I seek none but You.
So protect my precinct; be for me an impregnable fortress against every creature with fangs and claws, at every moment.
And spare me, O Possessor of Permanence and Eternity, the harm of whoever has walked toward me on foot,
and from the evil of whoever rides armed, and the evil of what flies with wings,
and from the evil of whoever sits (plotting) with words, and the evil of whoever lies down and whoever stands,
and from the evil of those who blow on knots (Qurʾān 113:4), and the evil of the envier and the denier.
Through You, O my God, I have bound (made harmless) the lion, the snake, the scorpion and the black viper,
the knot-tier, the blower, the thief, the caster of the evil eye, the sorcerer and the night-comer,
and men and jinn together, (keeping them) from me and from all who have submitted (to Islām) in what is open,
with a thousand thousand utterances of "There is no strength nor power save in God, Possessor of Loftiness".
And save me from the evil of the dwellers of the land, and the evil of every begetter and what he begot (Qurʾān 90:3).
And spare me the evil of the mouth and the eye, and of whoever has targeted me for ruin.
And save me from the wrong of every wrongdoer, and the evil of every ignorant and learned one,
of every silent one and every speaker, every renegade and every night-visitor,
of every vilest and every excellent one, every dominator and every assailant,
of every flier and every walker, every obscure and every renowned one,
of every envier and every hater, every tyrant and every criminal.
And save me, O You Who are exalted, O Glorious (Al-Majīd), from the evil of the jinn together with rebellious Satan,
from the evil of the near and the evil of the far, of heat and of cold, and the evil of water.
And make me a master and support me forever, and purify the heart and make the body sound.
And grant me standing (in prayer) in the nights and fasting in the day, with completeness.
And strip me of vices, and be the One Who adorns me with virtues.
And sharpen my mind, and open for me, Lord, a manifest opening (Qurʾān 48:1), such as is not seen for one like me.
And grant me skill and light, and on the Bridge (aṣ-Ṣirāṭ) make the crossing easy.
And grant me remembrance (of You) with gratitude at every moment, and count me among the Brought-Near.
And never cease, O my Sovereign, to be my guide; and refine me and be my close friend.
And teach me a knowledge from Your presence (Qurʾān 18:65), until I become firmly grounded, (vast as) an ocean.
And be my help against Satan, the self and creation, for the length of the ages.
And be for me, in the two Abodes, a refuge, and in them never cease to be my shelter.
And purify me in form and in heart, and grant me elevation and love.
And be my Patron in life and at my death, in the grave and at the Gathering (of the Resurrection), tomorrow.
And never cease, O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), to be for me protector, preserver, screen and well-pleased (with me),
drawing (to You), guide, teacher, leader to right guidance, honouring,
guide, helper, and the One Who gifts all that benefits me, possessed of kindness.
And make me travel the paths of deliverance, and spare me all sins.
And make me travel, Lord, the path of the saints, noble, sincere, chosen.
And bestow on me a felicity after which I see no misery or harm.
And make firm Your love in my heart, and the love of the best of creation, persistently,
and the love of his Family and all his Companions, then the love of every obedient Muslim.
O our Lord, O Possessor of gifts, answer my seeking of means through the Chosen, the elect;
then bless him with the best blessing, that leads me to meeting the guides.
And make me eager for the love of every Muslim, and save me from the evil of every criminal.
And make me eager for acts of obedience, and spare me sins and all trials.
